_about: Match and drop-card rewards (drop_card_drop) with all categories available: 15% camouflage, 10% decals, 37.5% armour and 37.5% weapons. Camouflage and decals are separate groups, so the server can skip a category once the player owns all its eligible items. generic_drop is left as it is: the server rolls no item from it (it reads only its rarity_points).
